properties.description: Mapping Data Flow migrated from DataStage CTransformerStage 'Trf_Jen'. Applies EREPLACE(ICONV(col,'MCP'),'|',' ') to all 26 columns. ICONV 'MCP' (Multi-Code-Page) encoding normalization is handled by ADF source encoding setting. EREPLACE is replicated with replace() expression function.

sources.name: SybaseJen
sources.description: Source from Sybase journal.dbo.jen via ODBC. Replaces DataStage CODBCStage 'Sybase_Jen_IBM_7_Dias'.

sinks.name: FileJournalJenIBM
sinks.description: Sink to pipe-delimited flat file. Replaces DataStage CSeqFileStage 'Seq_Jen'.

transformations.name: DerivedColumns_Trf_Jen
transformations.description: Replicates DataStage Transformer derivation: EREPLACE(ICONV(col,'MCP'),'|',' ') for all 26 columns. ICONV 'MCP' = encoding normalization (handled at source level). EREPLACE('|',' ') = replace pipe delimiter char with space to avoid column splitting in output.

typeProperties.script:
source(allowSchemaDrift: false,
     validateSchema: true,
     isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
     format: 'table') ~> SybaseJen
SybaseJen derive(
          jen_ope_evt = replace(toString(jen_ope_evt), '|', ' '),
          jen_fec_evt_neg = replace(toString(jen_fec_evt_neg), '|', ' '),
          jen_fec_ctb_evt = replace(toString(jen_fec_ctb_evt), '|', ' '),
          jen_rut_cli = replace(toString(jen_rut_cli), '|', ' '),
          jen_vrf_cli = replace(toString(jen_vrf_cli), '|', ' '),
          jen_rut_emp = replace(toString(jen_rut_emp), '|', ' '),
          jen_vrf_emp = replace(toString(jen_vrf_emp), '|', ' '),
          jen_id_cnl = replace(toString(jen_id_cnl), '|', ' '),
          jen_est_cnl = replace(toString(jen_est_cnl), '|', ' '),
          jen_suc_ori = replace(toString(jen_suc_ori), '|', ' '),
          jen_med = replace(toString(jen_med), '|', ' '),
          jen_id_med = replace(toString(jen_id_med), '|', ' '),
          jen_tip_opr_bci = replace(toString(jen_tip_opr_bci), '|', ' '),
          jen_id_opr = replace(toString(jen_id_opr), '|', ' '),
          jen_mod_tar = replace(toString(jen_mod_tar), '|', ' '),
          jen_fra_lin = replace(toString(jen_fra_lin), '|', ' '),
          jen_ara_cua = replace(toString(jen_ara_cua), '|', ' '),
          jen_id_svs = replace(toString(jen_id_svs), '|', ' '),
          jen_est_evt_neg = replace(toString(jen_est_evt_neg), '|', ' '),
          jen_id_pdt = replace(toString(jen_id_pdt), '|', ' '),
          jen_id_evt = replace(toString(jen_id_evt), '|', ' '),
          jen_id_sub_evt = replace(toString(jen_id_sub_evt), '|', ' '),
          jen_clv_ppl = replace(toString(jen_clv_ppl), '|', ' '),
          jen_mto = replace(toString(jen_mto), '|', ' '),
          jen_clv_sgd = replace(toString(jen_clv_sgd), '|', ' '),
          jen_cpo_var = replace(toString(jen_cpo_var), '|', ' ')
     ) ~> DerivedColumns_Trf_Jen
DerivedColumns_Trf_Jen sink(
          allowSchemaDrift: false,
          validateSchema: false,
          skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
          skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
          mapColumn(
               jen_ope_evt,
               jen_fec_evt_neg,
               jen_fec_ctb_evt,
               jen_rut_cli,
               jen_vrf_cli,
               jen_rut_emp,
               jen_vrf_emp,
               jen_id_cnl,
               jen_est_cnl,
               jen_suc_ori,
               jen_med,
               jen_id_med,
               jen_tip_opr_bci,
               jen_id_opr,
               jen_mod_tar,
               jen_fra_lin,
               jen_ara_cua,
               jen_id_svs,
               jen_est_evt_neg,
               jen_id_pdt,
               jen_id_evt,
               jen_id_sub_evt,
               jen_clv_ppl,
               jen_mto,
               jen_clv_sgd,
               jen_cpo_var
          )
     ) ~> FileJournalJenIBM

columnMappings.note: Timestamp converted to string by toString(). Output SqlType changed from 11 (TIMESTAMP) to 12 (VARCHAR 26) in DataStage transformer.
Timestamp converted to string by toString(). Output SqlType changed from 11 (TIMESTAMP) to 12 (VARCHAR 26) in DataStage transformer.
DECIMAL(18,4). APTFieldProp=quote=none in DataStage. toString() on decimal preserves numeric representation without quotes.

annotations: encoding_note: ICONV 'MCP' (MultiCodePage) in DataStage handles CP1252 encoding normalization. In ADF this is handled by the ODBC linked service encoding setting. No explicit conversion needed in the data flow.
pipe_replace_note: EREPLACE(...,'|',' ') prevents the pipe output delimiter from appearing inside field values. All 26 columns receive this treatment.
date_conversion_note: jen_fec_evt_neg and jen_fec_ctb_evt change from SqlType=11 (TIMESTAMP) to SqlType=12 (VARCHAR 26) in the transformer output, meaning DataStage serializes them as strings.
